items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: I had to work at Grand Island and I had to work at the island. See? So between Tony and Mr. LaVar, they straightened out.

ctx.x: No, I didn't stay down there. I just went down there and they had a wave on the Wednesday, come up on a Sunday morning, Monday morning. Then I run two bands. We had Miss LaVar at Grand Island and, not Grand Island, not, how do you call that? The room where you're touring is going.
